fields.howtochangedoctor:
How to Change Your Doctor:
  1. Click on Change my Doctor.
  2. Select “Primary Care” under Common Searches, then select “Primary Care Provider (PCP)”.
  3. Scroll down to find a Doctor that has the PCP indicator next to their name, it will say “Eligible to select as your Primary Care Provider.” Click on the Select option.
  4. New PCP effective date will be displayed upon successful completion of the PCP reassignment notification.
  5. My Doctor page will be updated to show your new PCP selection and effective date under the ‘New Doctor’ section.
